## detectSequenceType() function

Guesses whether an alignment holds nucleotide or amino-acid sequences, by looking for residues that only occur in the amino-acid alphabet. Used to pick a sensible default color style.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function detectSequenceType(sequences: readonly {
    sequence: string;
}[]): SequenceType;
```
